mapper.update: INSERT INTO admin_audit_log(id, administrator_user_id, action, object_type, object_id, result, safe_summary, occurred_at) VALUES (#{p.id}, #{p.administrator}, #{p.action}, #{p.objectType}, #{p.objectId}, #{p.result}, CAST(#{p.summary} AS jsonb), #{p.occurredAt})
mapper.sql: WHERE (#{p.administrator}='' OR a.username ILIKE #{p.administrator} ESCAPE '\') AND (#{p.action}='' OR l.action ILIKE #{p.action} ESCAPE '\') AND (#{p.object}='' OR l.object_type ILIKE #{p.object} ESCAPE '\' OR l.object_id ILIKE #{p.object} ESCAPE '\') AND (CAST(#{p.result} AS varchar) IS NULL OR l.result=CAST(#{p.result} AS varchar)) AND (CAST(#{p.startAt} AS timestamptz) IS NULL OR l.occurred_at>=CAST(#{p.startAt} AS timestamptz))
mapper.select:
SELECT l.id,a.username AS administrator,l.action,l.object_type,l.object_id,l.result, l.safe_summary::text AS safe_summary,l.occurred_at FROM admin_audit_log l JOIN app_user a ON a.id=l.administrator_user_id AND a.role='ADMIN'
ORDER BY l.occurred_at DESC,l.id DESC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM admin_audit_log l JOIN app_user a ON a.id=l.administrator_user_id AND a.role='ADMIN'
